name: Navbar
summary: The top bar with a brand, page links and actions, which folds its links into a native popover menu in narrow slots.
description: Use it as the main site or app header. Below 48rem of its own width (a container query, not the viewport) the links move into a sheet opened by the menu button, so the mobile menu works without JavaScript.

classes.name: v-navbar
classes.description: The bar. It is a size container, so it adapts to its slot.

classes.name: v-navbar-toggle
classes.description: The menu button that opens the links in narrow slots. Hidden when wide.

classes.name: v-navbar-menu
classes.description: The <nav popover> that holds the links and actions: inline when wide, a sheet from the end edge when narrow.

classes.name: v-navbar-close
classes.description: The close button inside the narrow sheet. Hidden when wide.

classes.name: v-navbar-actions
classes.description: Buttons such as Sign in and Get started, pushed to the end when wide.

states.description: On the link to the current page: underlined when wide, tinted in the sheet.
On .v-navbar-menu: lets the toggle open it as a sheet; Escape and a click outside close it.
On the toggle and close buttons: the id of the menu. The close button adds popovertargetaction="hide".

keyboard.action: Moves through the brand, links and actions, or the menu button when narrow.
On the menu button, opens the sheet. On a link, follows it.
Closes the open sheet and returns focus to the menu button.

a11y: The links sit in a <nav> with an aria-label, so it is listed as a landmark.
The menu and close buttons are icon-only, so each needs an aria-label.
Mark the current page with aria-current="page", not only with a colour.

examples.title: Navbar
examples.description: Links inline when the bar is at least 48rem wide. In a narrower frame the menu button opens them in a sheet.
